PR #42374 (first part of RFC #42082) has been split into 4 PRs:

#44454 [1/N][KV-Cache Layout Refactor] Refactor DSV4 KV cache config
#44455 [2/N][KV-Cache Layout Refactor] Pack K/V into the content dim across attention backends
#44456 [3/N][KV-Cache Layout Refactor] Standardize Mamba cache; drop `get_transfer_cache_regions`
-> #44458 [4/N][KV-Cache Layout Refactor] Standardize KV cache layout

## Summary

Final step of the KV-cache layout standardization ladder. Introduces standardized layout resolution and `reshape_kv_cache`, removes the legacy `get_kv_cache_shape` / `get_kv_cache_stride_order` APIs, and removes the remaining cross-layer block machinery from connectors. RFC #42082.

Stacked on top of #44456 (`bind_kv_cache`); the chain is #44454 → #44455 → #44456 → this PR. This is the restacked remainder of #42374, not a duplicate implementation of another open PR.

The rebase audit also fixed layout-sensitive regressions in compressed MLA allocation, CPU and XPU attention, NIXL, Mooncake, Mooncake Store, simple CPU offload, and in-place block copying. Coverage now includes layer-compact, cross-layer, separate-head-group, virtual-block-splitting, shared-storage, and host-buffer cases.

## Testing

Passed locally:

```bash
# All hooks on changed files, including ruff and mypy
pre-commit run --files <changed files>

# KV allocation and compressed-MLA coverage
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/v1/core/test_kv_cache_utils.py \
  tests/v1/attention/test_indexer_deepseek_v4_slot_mapping.py
# 70 passed

# Copy/offload layout coverage
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/v1/worker/test_attn_utils.py \
  tests/v1/simple_kv_offload/test_worker.py
# 22 passed

# Mooncake, Mooncake Store, and standardized Mamba registration
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_connector.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_connector_hybrid_mamba.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_store_worker.py
# 115 passed

# CPU layout and XPU sparse-MLA interface regressions
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/v1/attention/test_cpu_kv_cache_layout.py \
  tests/kernels/attention/test_xpu_mla_sparse.py \
  -k 'split_cpu_kv_cache or flattens_standard_cache'
# 6 passed

# NIXL registration across all layouts and separate head groups
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector.py \
  -k test_register_kv_caches
# 16 passed

VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=BLHNC .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -x \
  tests/compile/passes/test_fusion_attn.py
# 24 passed, 36 skipped

VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=BHLNC .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -x \
  tests/compile/passes/test_fusion_attn.py
# 24 passed, 36 skipped
```

The full NIXL unit file completed with 77 passed and 2 environment-only failures because NIXL is not installed in the local environment; all modified NIXL registration/handshake tests passed.

Model evaluations were not run locally because this is a cache-layout refactor with no intentional model-output change. GPU/XPU and multi-node accuracy coverage is delegated to CI and must be reviewed before merge.

## AI assistance

This PR was prepared with AI assistance (Claude and OpenAI Codex).
